description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build backend services and product features for a software platform used by financial professionals, working end to end from data systems through to automated outputs delivered to clients. The role centers on engineering judgment, deciding what to build and standing behind what ships, with close contact to the people who use the product.
 What you'll do
 - Develop backend services that handle large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
 - Build automated workflows that turn user requests into finished reports and documents.
 - Contribute across the stack, including front-end and infrastructure work where needed.
 - Shape how automated agents reason over business data and produce their outputs.
 - Work directly with clients to understand their needs and get new features into their hands quickly.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Two or more years of full-time software engineering experience, excluding contract, consulting, agency and internship work.
 - Strong backend development skills.
 - Heavy day-to-day use of AI programming tools in your work.
 - Strong sense of ownership, confidence and commitment to the success of the company.
 - Clear evidence of exceptional ability, such as a strong academic record or a career with fast progression at highly selective employers.
 - Enthusiasm for a small early-stage team and a specific reason for wanting to join it.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with Linux and cloud infrastructure.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 140,000 to 240,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - Seattle, WA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week
 - Full-time
